$comment: The bounded JSON response the text_title recipe requires (RCP-12, TOOL-06): ONE object, a title of at most 80 characters and a description of at most 240, stating only what the supplied text supports. The refusal shape is the only permitted alternative.
title: 2.4 release fixes asset-cache leak and gates certificate pinning
description: The release candidate notes a memory leak in the asset cache and moves certificate pinning behind a build flag enforced in packaged builds.
